_comment: Hero voices from the Freedom Speech catalog (tools/make-audio-fs.mjs --heroes) — since 13.11.2026 every character line; ISSAI is no longer used. Picked by measured median pitch of the catalog samples: the catalog has no child voices, so children use an adult voice raised a few semitones (boys ≈ 220–250 Hz, girls ≈ 250–310 Hz). Re-cast by editing a line and rerunning: only that hero is re-rendered.

APAI.why: storyteller voice, median 183 Hz — a calm teacher (target 160–250 Hz)

ANEL.why: brightest female voice, 258 Hz + 3 st ≈ 307 Hz — a 10-year-old girl (target 230–390 Hz)

ZHALKAU.why: 154 Hz + 6 st ≈ 218 Hz — a boy, a different timbre from Әлібек

AZHE.why: audiobook narrator, 192 Hz − 2 st ≈ 171 Hz — a grandmother

M1.why: 128 Hz + 1 st — Батыр-X, a bright young man

T4.why: 239 Hz + 2 st ≈ 268 Hz — Айсұлу Neon, an upbeat teenage girl

K1.why: 180 Hz + 5 st ≈ 240 Hz — Тайсон-Тайпақ, a boy

E1.why: deepest voice, 102 Hz — the auction judge
